title: Kafka consumer lag causing order processing delays
symptoms: Kafka consumer group 'order-processor' lag reached 450,000 messages. Order confirmation emails delayed by 4+ hours. Logs showing: KafkaTimeoutError: Request timed out after 30000 ms. Consumer throughput dropped from 5000 msg/s to 200 msg/s.
root_cause: A schema validation bug introduced in the latest deployment caused 60% of messages to fail deserialization. The consumer was retrying failed messages indefinitely instead of sending them to the dead-letter queue. This caused the consumer to bottleneck on a single partition.
fix_applied: 1. Rolled back deployment to previous version. 2. Implemented dead-letter queue for messages failing 3x deserialization. 3. Added consumer lag monitoring alert at 10,000 messages. 4. Fixed schema validation to be forward-compatible.
